scope: Complete the ten identified programme-level gaps as a coherent curated Worldwright expedition; preserve the original story and workshop.
reviewKind: Same-run author self-review, not independent verification or scientific admission

criteria.colour: Three shared light families with bounded regional variations; passages carry destination light.
criteria.motion: Purposeful response transitions, slow ambient motion, persistent pause/resume, and an operating-system reduced-motion branch. Pause persistence was checked in the browser; the OS branch was reviewed in source.
criteria.consistency: Shared navigation, source notes, status labels and interaction controls; persistent compass; searchable atlas.
criteria.aesthetic: Desktop and phone review of the atlas, interactive diagrams, material object, repair bench and quiet horizon.
criteria.beauty: Distinct authored symbols and encounters within a shared field-journal treatment; this is an author judgment, not an independently measured property.
criteria.truth: Bundled source-byte identities; explicit distinctions between reported results, declared toy models, open gates and optional interpretation.
criteria.goodness: No required personal disclosure, psychological assessment, compulsory theological conclusion or moral ranking of people. Alternatives and exits remain available. No contribution is sent on a reader's behalf.

browserChecks: Integer inflation and repetition-code correction limit
Experimental control and reported rate cards
Open cosmological gate and block aggregation
Conditional model result and explicit weights
Optional horizon and textual evidence rungs
Source-shelf link and source identity disclosure
Atlas search, empty result, and phone layout
boundaries: Coverage is not exhaustive exposition of every corpus document.
The small browser examples do not replay or replace the corpus's scientific certificates.
A document count or several renderings of one run do not create independent evidence.
Only visited scene IDs and the motion preference are persisted by the expedition reader.
Site access must be confirmed owner-private before publication.

automatedResult.scope: Application, source-byte identity and preserved workshop checks; same-run evidence.
